description: This file defines classes and enums for managing WebChat panels and windows within a macOS application, including a custom NSPanel subclass, a WebChatPresentation enum, and a singleton WebChatManager with session handling and UI control methods.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A custom NSPanel subclass that can accept key focus and main window status.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum representing how the WebChat can be presented (window or anchored panel).

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing WebChat sessions, presentation, and UI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a WebChat window for a given session key.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the anchored panel for a given session key, presenting or closing as needed.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the WebChat panel if open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and caches the preferred session key from the GatewayConnection.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Closes and resets all WebChat UI components and cached data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resets all tunnels, closing open windows and panels.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handler called when the panel is hidden, updates visibility callback.
